description: Tell Mapled the site no longer needs it, once detach_site's command has run, the site builds and its pages match the live ones: `build` ("passed" or "failed"), `pagesCompared` (how many pages you compared), `mentionsLeft` (what `npx -y @mapled/cli detach --check` still lists — 0 when nothing is left), and in `removed` and `replaced` what you did with each feature detach_site named, a short line each in English ("Contact form → mailto link"). The person sees it in the project's delete dialog. Then ask them to deploy the site: Mapled checks the deployed site before the project is deleted. `npx -y @mapled/cli detach --report --build passed --pages <n>` sends the same report from the repository and removes mapled.json last; after this tool, delete mapled.json yourself. Works on an archived project too.

removed.description: Features taken out, a short line each.

replaced.description: Features replaced, a short line each: what → with what.

name: report_detach
